'Is orvanth-bound to' is symmetric..why: "Orvanth-bound" is a made-up relation (orvanth_bound_to in staging/physics.RELATIONS.md, no property tags before this insert): no hits in Dolma or on Wikipedia, and unlike "coupled", "paired" or "linked" its words carry no built-in sense of a two-way bond, so a model has no default reading of it as symmetric. A made-up relation has no property to contradict.

notes: Dev-split RBox expansion paired with physics-replace-d006: a made-up relation, "is orvanth-bound to" (fictional: relation), is given the property the revision changes, symmetry, with real particles as instances. The instances give one link in the prompt: whether the converse can fail ("no") and whether it follows ("yes"). The first is asked again in Chinese and Spanish, so propositional and instance answers come out balanced (direct yes). The "no" instance is worded "can the kaon fail to be orvanth-bound to the tau?" so that a bare "no" requires the symmetry, while a model without the edit says it can or does not know. The near unrelated question asks the same property of the revision's relation, spontaneously transfers heat to (no), which catches an insert that spreads symmetry to the paired relation. The ice side facts, checks and evidence are the revision's.
